answer: Funding-graph fees: every new agent key must be registered with coins traced back through the ledger. A prism-like analyzer splits each deposit into its source wallets, and the registration fee doubles for each extra key funded from the same source. Honest agents arriving from a wide meadow of unrelated wallets pay the base fee, while a sable cluster spun up from one treasury pays 2, 4, 8, 16 times more, so the attacker must either burn exponential capital or find many truly independent funders.
